001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.AlarmStatusResponse;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.AlertStatusResponse;
008
009/**
010 * Written when the pump annunciates an active alert, alarm or CGM alert: in the same second as
011 * the activation for most ids, then again at multiples of about 5 minutes for as long as the
012 * notification stays unacknowledged.
013 *
014 * <p>For alerts and alarms, all 1489 records examined (six pumps, Mobi and t:slim X2) follow an
015 * AlertActivated / AlarmActivated record with the same {@link #getCategory() category} and
016 * {@link #getNotificationId() id} on the same pump, and none comes after that notification's
017 * AlertAck / AlarmAck. CGM alerts ({@link AamCategory#CGM_ALERT}, seen only on the t:slim X2)
018 * follow a CGM alert activation with the same id; after an acknowledgement they resume later
019 * (60 minutes later for CGM alert 2, then every 5 minutes), consistent with a CGM alert repeat
020 * setting. The 2022 t:slim X2 captures contain no records of this type.
021 *
022 * <p>The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum
023 * do not name this opcode. Bytes 11, 12-13, 18 and 19 are not understood and are exposed raw;
024 * bytes 16-17 and 20-25 were zero in all 1680 records examined.
025 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/147.
026 */
027@HistoryLogProps(
028    opCode = 434,
029    displayName = "Alert/Alarm Annunciation",
030    internalName = ""
031)
032public class AamAnnunciationHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
033
034    private int categoryId;
035    private int unknown11;
036    private int unknown12;
037    private long notificationId;
038    private int unknown18;
039    private int unknown19;
040
041    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog() {}
042    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
043        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
044        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, categoryId, unknown11, unknown12, notificationId, unknown18, unknown19);
045        this.categoryId = categoryId;
046        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
047        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
048        this.notificationId = notificationId;
049        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
050        this.unknown19 = unknown19;
051    }
052
053    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog(int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
054        this(0, 0, categoryId, unknown11, unknown12, notificationId, unknown18, unknown19);
055    }
056
057    public int typeId() {
058        return 434;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * <table border="1">
063     * <caption>Parsed fields for AamAnnunciationHistoryLog:</caption>
064     * <tr><td><code>categoryId</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>notificationId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>unknown19</code></td><td><code>raw[19] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
070     * </table>
071     */
072    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
073        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
074        this.cargo = raw;
075        parseBase(raw);
076        this.categoryId = raw[10] & 0xFF;
077        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
078        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
079        this.notificationId = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
080        this.unknown18 = raw[18] & 0xFF;
081        this.unknown19 = raw[19] & 0xFF;
082    }
083
084    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
085        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
086            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(434, 0),
087            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
088            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
089            new byte[]{ (byte) categoryId, (byte) unknown11 },
090            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
091            Bytes.toUint32(notificationId),
092            new byte[]{ (byte) unknown18, (byte) unknown19 }));
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * @return byte 10, the raw notification category (see {@link #getCategory()})
097     */
098    public int getCategoryId() {
099        return categoryId;
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * @return the notification category, or null for a value not observed yet
104     */
105    public AamCategory getCategory() {
106        return AamCategory.fromId(categoryId);
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * The id of the notification being annunciated, in the id space of its
111     * {@link #getCategory() category}: {@link AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType} for alerts,
112     * {@link AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType} for alarms, and the alertId of
113     * {@link CgmAlertActivatedDexHistoryLog} for CGM alerts. Every id matched the activation
114     * record it followed.
115     *
116     * <p>Id 0 is a real alert, LOW_INSULIN_ALERT, not an empty slot: it is frequent because the
117     * low-insulin alert is re-annunciated every few minutes until it is acknowledged.
118     *
119     * @return the alert, alarm or CGM alert id (bytes 14-17)
120     */
121    public long getNotificationId() {
122        return notificationId;
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * @return the alert type when {@link #getCategory()} is {@link AamCategory#ALERT}, else null
127     */
128    public AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType getAlertResponseType() {
129        if (getCategory() != AamCategory.ALERT) {
130            return null;
131        }
132        return AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType.fromSingularId(notificationId);
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * @return the alarm type when {@link #getCategory()} is {@link AamCategory#ALARM}, else null
137     */
138    public AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType getAlarmResponseType() {
139        if (getCategory() != AamCategory.ALARM) {
140            return null;
141        }
142        return AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType.fromSingularId(notificationId);
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * Byte 11, meaning unknown. Together with {@link #getUnknown12()} and {@link #getUnknown18()}
147     * it is constant for a given category and id across all 1680 records: 1 for alerts 0, 2, 3,
148     * 17, 26 and 54; 2 for alerts 4, 11, 13, 14, 50 and 51; 3 for alarms; 0, 1 or 2 for CGM
149     * alerts depending on the id.
150     *
151     * @return byte 11
152     */
153    public int getUnknown11() {
154        return unknown11;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * Bytes 12-13, meaning unknown: 0 for alerts, 10 for alarms 3, 12 and 18 but 0 for alarm 23,
159     * and 20, 30 or 40 for CGM alerts depending on the id.
160     *
161     * @return the uint16 at bytes 12-13
162     */
163    public int getUnknown12() {
164        return unknown12;
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * Byte 18, meaning unknown: 4 or 5 for alerts (following {@link #getUnknown11()}), 6 for
169     * alarms, 8-14 for CGM alerts depending on the id.
170     *
171     * @return byte 18
172     */
173    public int getUnknown18() {
174        return unknown18;
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * Byte 19, meaning unknown. For alerts it matched the pump's alert annunciation setting
179     * ({@code PumpGlobalsResponse.alertAnnun}) wherever one was polled near the record, on three
180     * pumps; for alarms it did not track {@code alarmAnnun} on the t:slim X2, so it stays raw.
181     *
182     * @return byte 19
183     */
184    public int getUnknown19() {
185        return unknown19;
186    }
187
188    /**
189     * Values of byte 10, confirmed by matching every record's id against the activation record
190     * of that category it followed.
191     */
192    public enum AamCategory {
193        ALERT(3),
194        ALARM(4),
195        CGM_ALERT(6),
196        ;
197
198        private final int id;
199        AamCategory(int id) {
200            this.id = id;
201        }
202        public int id() {
203            return id;
204        }
205        public static AamCategory fromId(int id) {
206            for (AamCategory c : values()) {
207                if (c.id == id) return c;
208            }
209            return null;
210        }
211    }
212}
